rappel_detail.anchor: natural: a sling around a boulder or horn (the slung-boulder landmark from the approach); build or back up
rappel_detail.station: The top of the cliff band on the south face, at the hidden chimney and Class 4 step.
rappel_detail.notes: Optional. Most parties downclimb this face-to-face, belaying weaker members, to avoid knocking loose rock onto climbers below. If you rappel, bring at least a 45 m single rope; a 30 m rope leaves you short and forces a further downclimb.
hazards: Loose, debris-prone rock: stagger the party and keep helmets on.

set.rappels: Usually none: most parties downclimb the cliff band. 1 optional rappel through it from a slung boulder needs at least a 45 m rope
